summary: Tested Phase 1: (1) Lot-hiding on sale bill vs purchase voucher, (2) Debit Notes CRUD + ledger sync, (3) Searchable/autocomplete dropdowns across Purchases/Sales/Price Lists/Debit Notes/Ledger. All three features work end-to-end. Backend pytest 3/3 pass. Frontend: Debit Notes creates (DN-00004) via searchable Party combobox, appears in ledger as DEBIT (Ramesh Traders shows DN-00001 ₹750, DN-00002 ₹321, DN-00004 ₹555 with closing receivable ₹1,626). PDF extraction confirms INV-00001 contains NO 'Lot No' text while PUR-00003 contains 'Lot No: LOTX-1'. Sale creation via searchable party+product combos succeeds.

design_issues.screen: CrudPage Dialog (all forms incl. Debit Notes)
issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — a11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'.
Date field default is empty — DN-00004 was saved with date '-' when the user leaves it blank. Consider defaulting to today (like Purchases/Sales).

action_items: Optional: default Debit Note 'date' field to today's date (currently blank -> saves as '-').
Optional: add aria-describedby/DialogDescription to CrudPage form dialogs to silence a11y warnings.
Cleanup: pytest fixture leftover DN-00002 (₹321, reason 'TEST_pytest') exists in seeded tenant ledger (pytest itself cleans up, but earlier smoke run left one). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: downloadInvoicePdf correctly gates lot printing on isSale (purchase-only). Clean minimal fix, doc.lot_no is still stored server-side (verified: sales list returns lot_no='LOTX-1' for INV-00001).
SearchableSelect: options rely on cmdk value=label — if two options share the same label, cmdk filtering and selection can collide. Consider passing a unique id in the cmdk value.
Debit Notes backend (server.py L646-688) mirrors credit notes correctly, sync_ledger uses ref_type='debit_note' and delete cascades ledger rows. Good.
seed_data_creation: Created UI debit note DN-00004 (Ramesh Traders, INV-UI-1, ₹555). Pytest creates/edits/deletes its own DN (verified via ledger delta).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Debit Notes route /admin/debit-notes; testids prefix 'debit-notes'. SearchableSelect renders inside Radix Dialog — needs ~400ms wait after opening popover before typing. PDF check: pypdf installed; INV-00001 must NOT contain 'Lot No', PUR-00003 must contain 'Lot No: LOTX-1'.
